answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the basalt graph is rebuilt each epoch, the horizon merge is applied at settlement and the anchor audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 33 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 36 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
